claims.text: The Load Controller prepares the preliminary load plan by T-90.
claims.quote: The Load Controller shall prepare the preliminary load plan by T-90.

claims.text: The Load Control Lead approves the preliminary load plan before release to Ramp.
claims.quote: The preliminary load plan shall be approved by the Load Control Lead before release to Ramp.

claims.text: Special loads are checked against the acceptance checklist before loading.
claims.quote: Special loads shall be checked against the acceptance checklist before loading.

claims.text: Where actual weights deviate beyond the airline tolerance, the Load Control Lead decides on corrective action.
claims.quote: Where actual weights deviate from planned beyond the airline tolerance, the Load Control Lead shall decide on corrective action.

claims.text: The final load sheet is issued through the departure control system no later than T-10.
claims.quote: The final load sheet shall be issued through the departure control system no later than T-10.

unknowns.question: Which role issues the final load sheet?
